verdict.rationale: Turso documents official SDKs in TypeScript, Python, Rust, and Go with concrete quickstart usage (push/pull, embedded replicas), and this is corroborated by a CLI/local-dev runtime probe showing real SQL execution over a supported protocol. This directly satisfies 'build against official SDKs' for AI-native/agentic use, including per-agent database provisioning via API and MCP integration for agent-driven management. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the non-TS SDKs (Python/Rust/Go) specifically, beyond the TS quickstart and vendor docs.
